summary: Yodyut Muaythai is a Muay Thai gym on Koh Samui offering group and private training for beginners and fighters, with class, weekly and monthly prices.

facts.label: Founded
facts.quote: Founded in 2014 by former Muaythai champion Yodyut Kiatyongyut.

facts.label: Group class times
facts.value: Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 10:00 and 17:00 to 19:00

facts.label: Monthly
facts.value: 5,500 THB for 1 class per day, 8,000 THB for 2
facts.quote: 1 Month — 5,500 THB 1 class per day / 8,000 THB 2 class per day

facts.label: Policies
facts.value: Memberships cannot be paused and no refunds
